entities.summary: Kevin Labanc is an American professional ice hockey right winger for the Shanghai Dragons of the Kontinental Hockey League. He formerly played for the San Jose Sharks and Columbus Blue Jackets in the National Hockey League. San Jose drafted him in the sixth round, 171st overall, of the 2014 NHL entry draft.
